of-source: tools/aot_cover.pin.json:covered_ops (read, not copied: the two routes must not drift apart, and the two pins are never added)

_why: totals+live means the row pins how many blocks and bytes the whole
program took and that nothing survived the sweep -- NOT that any
particular write copied a region.  the-copy means the two programs
differ by exactly one remove() and their readings differ by exactly
the doubling a frontier copy costs, so the row can tell the copy

note: regenerate with tools/aot_mir_cover.test.py --pin.  The fraction a
reader sees in IR-AOT-MIR is this file.  coverage-claim=none says
what the number is not: covering the corpus is not covering the
lowering, which is why emittable= and the missing reasons are
recorded next to it, and why the denominator is read from the AST
route's pin instead of being written down twice.
covered/of is about the SHARED corpus only.  Programs the AST route
refuses (a string expression is one) are measured on their own and
reported as beyond-ast-denominator=, because folding their opcodes
into `of` would make the fraction a statement about a corpus the
first front end cannot run -- and would make `missing` vacuous.
